welcome.headline: Where Sequins Meet Subwoofers
welcome.text:
Disco Dingo started life as a single glitter-covered speaker in a backyard, and it never really stopped growing from there. These days we’re a proper venue with a proper sound system, but the spirit is exactly the same: turn the lights down, turn the bass up, and let everybody find their groove.

Whether you’re a seasoned regular who can do the hustle in your sleep or you’ve never set foot on a dance floor before, our resident DJs and our disco-obsessed mascot will have you moving within the first thirty seconds. That’s a promise, not a threat.

mascot.headline: Meet Disco Dingo
mascot.text:
Our mascot, Disco Dingo, showed up at the very first night wearing sunglasses and a gold medallion, and frankly nobody had the heart to ask him to leave. He now greets every guest at the door, judges the dance-offs, and has strong opinions about which songs deserve a key change.

"Come for the music, stay for the mirror ball, leave with a slightly sore neck from all the head-bopping." — Disco Dingo
